_source: findings/25_stork_mozart.md:473-649, cross-checked directly against real files under mozart/app/testdata/fts/rbl/v1/{transfer_init,transfer_status,gateway_auth,account_balance}/. Real Mozart -mock matches a scenario by an EXACT string match on one specific field of the flattened inbound request -- transfer_init keys on entities.attempt.amount, *_status actions key on entities.attempt.gateway_ref_no (mozart/app/mock/mappings.go). Route shape: POST /{namespace}/{gateway}/{version}/{action}, e.g. /fts/rbl/v1/transfer_init.
_gap_note: Real Mozart -mock is a STATIC fixture replay (one request field value -> one fixed response, no server-side state). The task's 'pending -> processed after 2 polls' scenario needs per-call-count state, which the real Mozart -mock cannot do. Two options, both documented: (a) use the lightweight stateful mozart-sim substitute (Python, ENV2_COMPOSE-style) for that one scenario only, keeping real Mozart -mock for the other 5; (b) accept a simplified single-poll pending->processed and note the fidelity gap. This spec assumes (a).
